title: Yellow Pygmy Sunflower - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Dwarf Yellow Sunflower
description:
Compact & Cheerful: Perfect for Pots and Pollinators!




 KEY FEATURES


• Compact dwarf variety, perfect for small gardens, pots and containers


• Bright lemon-yellow flowers with dark centres, attracting bees and pollinators


• Excellent for cut flower arrangements, bringing sunshine indoors


• Easy to grow and low maintenance, suitable for gardeners of all levels


• Edible seeds can be harvested from mature flower heads




 PLANT DETAILS


Type: Vegetables — Helianthus annuus


Colour: Yellow (with brown centre)


Season: Summer through Autumn (July-October)


Growth Habit: Upright


Flavour: Mild, nutty (for seeds)


Time to Harvest: 3-5 months (for seeds)




 GROWING CONDITIONS


Sun: Full sun


Soil: Well-drained, fertile, rich in organic matter


Watering: Average, water well, especially in warm weather


Spacing: 8 to 15 cm


Height: 40-55 cm


Spread: 30 cm


Hardiness: UK zones 1-10 (Annual)




 CARE INSTRUCTIONS


• Plant in a sunny location with well-drained soil.


• Water regularly, especially during dry periods, and feed when flowering begins.


• Protect young seedlings from slugs and snails using copper tape or grit.


• Support taller plants with stakes if needed to keep them upright.


• Harden off plants gradually before planting outdoors after the last frost.




 WHAT'S INCLUDED


2x Mini Plug Plants
